@@ -35,0 +35,1 @@ +import jdk.incubator.code.internal.ConstantValueAnalysis; @@ -38,1 +39,0 @@ -import java.lang.invoke.MethodHandles; @@ -105,17 +105,0 @@ - *

- * This method deviates from the language specification of a constant expression in the following cases. - *

    - *
  • A name that refers to a final class variable of primitive type or type String, is evaluated as if a constant variable. - * Such referral is modeled as field load operation to a static final field. At runtime, it is not possible to - * determine if that class variable, the static final field, is initialized with a constant expression. - *
  • A name that refers to constant variable that is an instance variable is evaluated as if it is a - * non-constant variable, and therefore any expression referring to such a variable is not considered a constant - * expression. - * Such referral is modeled as field load operation to a non-static final field. At runtime, it is not possible - * to access the value of the field, since the instance of the class that has the field that is the instance - * variable is unknown. And, same as the first case, at runtime it is not possible to determine if the variable - * is initialized with a constant expression, whose value is independent of the class instance. - *
  • An effectively final local variable is evaluated as if a constant variable. - * Such a variable is modelled as a variable operation, which does not model if the variable is a final - * variable. - *
